checks.foreign: FARA: the bulk FARA files (all registrants, short-form registrants, foreign principals) were searched by exact name on 2026-10-13 by the records collector and re-checked here; the loose name matches in that output are other people, and nothing matches this candidate. 2026 House candidate report: no foreign-government ties; holds stock in three foreign-domiciled companies (Enbridge, Toyota, Medtronic) through a joint brokerage account. note.t: 2026 candidate report (filed May 25, 2026; covers Jan. 1, 2025–Apr. 15, 2026). Assets of $1.0M–$2.4M: his Enterprise home (joint, $250K–$500K), a one-third interest in Mount Vernon farm property held in the Marques Family Trust ($250K–$500K), his spouse's Orrville property, River Bank & Trust stock ($50K–$100K), and a joint Edward Jones brokerage with individual stocks — Amazon, Berkshire Hathaway, Exxon Mobil and Walmart ($50K–$100K each), plus Altria, Enbridge, Medtronic, Nvidia, Southern Co., Toyota and Verizon ($15K–$50K each) — and retirement accounts. Income: Alabama legislative salary ($62,212 in 2025), salary from Jim Whaley Tires/Telle Tire, and his spouse's Edward Jones salary. Liabilities: a PennyMac mortgage ($250K–$500K), an American Express balance ($15K–$50K) and two small vehicle loans. Foreign-company stocks only (Enbridge – Canada, Toyota – Japan, Medtronic – Ireland-domiciled), no foreign-government ties. Candidate reports have no transaction schedule.
